# Paths excluded from repository tracking and live repo-symlinking.
# Enforced by arch/dots-hyprland.sh verify, bootstrap.sh, and phase assert suites.
# v0.5 Material You Desktop Shell Dynamic Outputs:
# 1. kdeglobals: Actively churned by kde-material-you-colors on wallpaper change (Q7: empirical resolution).
# 2. Kvantum: Upstream theme engine directory synced by dots-hyprland installer.
# 3. gtk-3.0/gtk.css: Dynamically generated by Matugen from wallpaper colors.
# 4. gtk-4.0/gtk.css: Dynamically generated by Matugen (de-linked from root-owned Catppuccin) (Q8: empirical resolution).
# 5. fuzzel/fuzzel_theme.ini: Dynamically generated by Matugen for Fuzzel launcher.
# 6. hypr/hyprland/colors.lua: Dynamically generated by Matugen for Hyprland window borders.
# 7. hypr/hyprlock/colors.conf: Dynamically generated by Matugen for Hyprlock screen locker.
# 8. kde-material-you-colors: Generator runtime configuration and state directory.
